verses.1: For the healing of David’s illness.
verses.2: Nabal said in his heart, “There is no God. They have corrupted and destroyed everything. There is no one who does good deeds.”
verses.3: God, who looks down from heaven upon human beings, sees that there is someone who is wise and seeks out God.
verses.4: They all act together, but no one does anything good. No one even tries to do anything at all.
verses.5: They did not know that the people of Awn ate bread as food. They did not call upon God.
verses.6: There would be no fear at all. There wouldn’t be any fear because God has opened up His treasures to us. God is merciful.
verses.7: Who will give Israel hope again, when God brings them back from their captivity? Jacob will be rejoiced, and Israel will be happy.
